pages.recipe:
麻婆豆腐 · Mapo tofu

Silky tofu in a red, numbing sauce. The version you can make on a Tuesday, with one jar of doubanjiang.

10 minPrep
15 minCook
MediumHeat
SichuanRegion

Ingredients

2servings

    1. Blanch the tofu

      Cut into 2 cm cubes. Simmer in salted water for 2 minutes to firm it up, then drain gently.

    2. Fry the base

      Brown the mince, then add doubanjiang and black beans and fry until the oil turns red.

    3. Simmer

      Add stock and tofu. Slide the pan rather than stir, so the cubes stay whole. Four minutes.

    4. Thicken and finish

      Pour in the slurry in two goes. Finish with ground Sichuan pepper and spring onion.

Techniques · 技法

滑

Velveting

Marinate sliced meat in egg white, cornflour and a splash of wine for a silky texture.

爆

Bao: high-heat flash fry

Very hot wok, small batches, ninety seconds. Everything stays crisp.

蒸

Steaming

Boil first, then lower in the food. Cover tight. Add 30 seconds for each extra centimetre.

Wok & Steam began as a notebook of the dishes my mother cooked from memory. Every recipe here is cooked at least three times before it is written. Replace this with your own story and photo.
pages.faq:
Home/FAQ

FAQ

Do I need a carbon-steel wok?

No. A wide frying pan works; a wok just helps with tossing.

Can I substitute Shaoxing wine?

Dry sherry is the closest. Use the same amount.

Where do I buy doubanjiang?

Any Asian grocery, or online. Look for "Pixian" on the label.
